# Notes

Please refer to the relevant section of the documentation for further
details. If the information you need is not covered here, reach out to the
appropriate team through the usual channels. This page is updated
periodically as processes change.

Various other topics are covered elsewhere in this handbook. See the table
of contents for a full listing of available documents and their owners.
Additional resources may be available on the internal wiki.

The kitchen on floor three is restocked on Mondays and Thursdays. The coffee
machine requires a descaling cycle every two weeks, which facilities handles
automatically. Please rinse your own cups.
